supportedRuntimes.orchestration: Docker Engine with Docker Compose v2

testedPlatforms.coverage: Required automated gate: complete disposable-stack release acceptance
Required automated gate: image build and metadata validation

knownLimitations: Native Raspberry Pi runtime acceptance and a 0.3.0-to-0.4.0 upgrade, backup restoration and rollback check of the exact published candidate images are required before stable promotion; source-built Pi deployments do not satisfy those release gates.
TeslaMate 4.0.2 through 4.1.x are bounded by the tested 4.0.1 and 4.2.0 endpoints rather than dedicated fixtures for every intermediate release.
One vehicle per installation is the current supported focus.
Odovi requires an existing supported TeslaMate database and does not bundle TeslaMate.
